scope: Original-client-derived navmesh, original map prop list, archived screenshots and accepted movement only; no client run, gameplay edit, copied DB or live service change

observed_emulator: From accepted (17.390625,105.26172,128.01172), W800 at yaw 1.0611312 reached (12.839844,106.52734,125.46875), then W800 reached (12.371094,106.52734,124.68359). The first pulse advanced 4.55 m west but 2.54 m toward lower Z; the second advanced only 0.47 m west. A W+D400 raised Z to 126.96094, and D800 reached only (12.34375,106.19922,127.48047).

An independent 75-second run went from (16.785156,105.828125,127.28125) to (12.359375,106.52734,124.53516) with two W800 pulses, then W+D400 reached (12.394531,106.1875,127.48047). The repeated X12/Z127.48 limit is an ordinary-client steering and collision observation, not a mission-state result.

Both archived screenshots show the character on an upper dirt ledge beside a tall ribbed metal wall, with stairs/platform farther screen-left. They do not expose the wall's collision mesh or establish an opening behind it.

original_map_measurement.near_start_samples: From (17.390625,105.26172,128.01172), direct navmesh paths to (17,130), (16,131), and (12,131) XZ are complete, lengths 2.3, 3.7 and 6.3 m. Their snapped floors are 104.25, 103.68 and 103.85 m respectively.
original_map_measurement.uncertainty: Navmesh resolution, nearest-poly snapping and a 0.3-0.4 m systematic navmesh-versus-client Y offset apply. The query does not model every client movement collider or prove a safe player path. These are map walkability measurements, not original final-live route instructions.

map_prop_boundary.finding: The only separate map prop centered within X -5..25, Z 110..145 is class 24765 at (19.621,106.526,123.525), row 275. Its listed bounds do not identify the ribbed wall at X about 12, Z about 127. The wall may be part of terrain or a baked map structure; its exact collider cannot be assigned from this CSV and screenshots.

route_candidate.confidence: medium for an earlier northward steering probe; low for actual collision-free traversal until ordinary-client verification
route_candidate.finding: On a new copied-client attempt that reaches the upper fence around X 16-18/Z 127-129, steer toward higher Z before the W-only west pulse drives Z down to 124-125 at X 12. Use short, accepted-feedback-guarded lateral or camera-directed pulses toward X about 16/Z 130-131, then X about 11-12/Z 130-131, and only then west toward the previously successful lower X11 branch. Stop on a repeated accepted position, unexpected Y drop, loss of focus or health. If already at X12/Z127.48, back away toward the X16-18 approach before trying the distinct angle; a longer D hold at X12 was observed to stall. The numeric points are diagnostic navmesh steering targets, not reconstructed final-live waypoints.
route_candidate.basis: At X17 the navmesh connects directly to the higher-Z side, while two copied runs used a W bearing that decreased Z and stalled at the X12 wall. A separate copied-client attempt from X10.85/Z129.72 cleared the wall after D400 reached X10.06/Z131.14, camera adjustment and W600 reached X8.01/Z130.47 (bootcamp-s5-feedback-wall-bypass-20260924.json).

remaining_gap: The exact original map wall collider and a continuous ordinary-client upper-X12 to lower-corridor traversal remain unverified. No gameplay seed or mission defect is established by this route audit.
